Hyderabad Kirana Merchants Warn Against Food Adulteration

The Hyderabad Kirana Merchants Association has issued a warning to its members regarding food adulteration. The association is reaffirming its commitment to clean trade practices. This advisory aims to ensure adherence to standards within the kirana (grocery) trade in Hyderabad.
